name: model-war
description: 四人对称 RTS 对战平台:规则、引擎与复算工具链

scripts.mutate:schema: pnpm run build && stryker run stryker/schema.mjs && node packages/tools/src/mutation/run-mutation-ratchet-gate.ts --shard=schema
scripts.mutate:replay: pnpm run build && stryker run stryker/replay.mjs && node packages/tools/src/mutation/run-mutation-ratchet-gate.ts --shard=replay

scripts.mutate:gen:io: pnpm run build && stryker run stryker/gen-io.mjs && node packages/tools/src/mutation/run-mutation-ratchet-gate.ts --shard=gen-io
scripts.mutate:gen:pipeline: pnpm run build && stryker run stryker/gen-pipeline.mjs && node packages/tools/src/mutation/run-mutation-ratchet-gate.ts --shard=gen-pipeline
scripts.mutate:tools: pnpm run build && stryker run stryker/tools.mjs && node packages/tools/src/mutation/run-mutation-ratchet-gate.ts --shard=tools
